patterns: Feeders are scattered. No single earlier show fed more than one EYL guest in this sample (every count is 1). The common thread is founder-story and personal-finance interview shows (Kara Goldin, Behind Her Empire, ChooseFI, Journey to Launch, Rushion McDonald), plus some larger shows (Angela Yee, School of Hard Knocks, Akademiks). Invest Fest sponsorships and speaking slots look like a direct pipeline. No South Florida-recorded feeder was found. Gap: the search budget (shared limit of 200 per turn) ran out after about 45 searches. Several guests have no prior-appearance search and many dates are approximate. All audience sizes and booking routes are unverified.
avery_path: Start with Rushion McDonald's Money Making Conversations / Follow Your Passion and The Kara Goldin Show, which fit Avery's Black-artist, celebrity and founder story best, then do ChooseFI or Journey to Launch with an art-as-an-asset angle. Bring EYL a short reel from those episodes, ArtLife sales and growth numbers, and the Alec Monopoly brand-collaboration case. Also pursue an Invest Fest speaking or sponsor slot, which appears to be a direct route onto the show. No South Florida feeder show was found for EYL.

target_booking_note: Guests skew toward hip-hop insiders: legacy rappers, DJs, label executives (Ruff Ryders CEO Dee Dean, Ray Daniels), managers and comedians, often from the hosts' own NY and Miami networks. No public guest application was found.
